title: Fix Model Object To Group Input Kind and Recursive Layer Grouping
description: ModelObject to Group does not handle Rhino ModelObject output of Import Model. Input 1 must accept Rhino ModelObject, support list inputs, recursively bundle all layers into a group, and accept Model Objects in general.
summary: ModelObject To Group now produces native GH_GeometryGroup output only, recursively grouped by Rhino layer path, with geometry from Import Model Rhino model objects; removed semio-group conversion path from this component.
